title_idea: EU imposes provisional safeguard measures on grain-oriented electrical steel imports effective 18 September 2026
keyword: EU provisional safeguard measures grain-oriented electrical steel 2026 importer cost
angle: This article lets importers of grain-oriented electrical steel, laminations, cores, and transformers with incorporated cores adjust their sourcing and pricing to comply with the new provisional tariff-rate quota and price threshold rules that entered into force 18 September 2026.

figures.evidence: After analysing input received from interested parties during an investigation launched in March 2026 , the Commission concluded that provisional measures were urgently needed to protect a strategic EU industry that is under threat from high import pressure – fuelled by global overcapacities and the closure of traditional export markets.
